title: CDLS: Constraint Driven Generative AI Framework for Analog Layout Synthesis
problem: Analog circuit layout generation remains predominantly a slow manual process in advanced process nodes, where layout parasitics and layout-dependent effects critically impact performance. This bottleneck impedes rapid design convergence and slows down the analog design cycle.
motivation: Automating analog layout synthesis directly addresses a critical design bottleneck, enabling faster iteration cycles and accelerating overall design convergence.
method: CDLS uses generative AI and machine learning to automatically learn and generate design constraints that drive automated placement and routing for analog circuits. These learned constraints replace traditional manual specification, enabling the framework to produce simulation-ready layouts. The approach is evaluated on industrial analog designs using Intel sub-10nm process technology.
key_novelty: Using generative AI to automatically learn domain-specific layout constraints that drive analog placement and routing, replacing manual constraint engineering with learned constraint generation.
contributions: Constraint-driven generative AI framework for automated analog layout synthesis
2-3X reduction in layout iteration time on industrial analog designs
30% reduction in overall design convergence cycle
Demonstration of layout quality parity with manual layouts on state-of-the-art analog circuits
limitations: Evaluation limited to Intel sub-10nm process node; generalization to other process technologies and potential scalability limitations not discussed.
primary_theme: Generative AI for automated analog layout synthesis
